caption: The drawing depicts a long, light-colored dress with a fitted bodice and short, puffed sleeves. The dress features thin vertical yellow stripes and is adorned with a delicate floral pattern in multiple colors including pink, blue, green, and yellow. There are two prominent pink ribbons tied into bows on each sleeve. The bodice appears to be decorated with diagonal pleating or ruching, and the neckline is wide and rounded. To the right of the main colored illustration, there is a smaller, uncolored line drawing of the same dress shown from the back, displaying the dress structure and how the skirt falls naturally. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no additional objects present.
title: Dress
